meta.title: Bloody Battle
meta.description: All of Magrasea shall judge your misdeeds.

units.rawText: You should not have done this... Eosphorus.
units.displayText: You should not have done this... Eosphorus.

spans.text: You should not have done this... Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Are these your last words?
units.displayText: Are these your last words?

spans.text: Are these your last words?

units.rawText: You've forgotten your fallen friends' sacrifices, stood against us as an enemy, and even struck Atlas down without mercy.
units.displayText: You've forgotten your fallen friends' sacrifices, stood against us as an enemy, and even struck Atlas down without mercy.

spans.text: You've forgotten your fallen friends' sacrifices, stood against us as an enemy, and even struck Atlas down without mercy.

units.rawText: She looks aside, at the heavily-wounded Atlas, whose face has a pained grimace on it. Because she had no operand shielding, the latter used his own body to physically block the starlight summoned by Eos.
units.displayText: She looks aside, at the heavily-wounded Atlas, whose face has a pained grimace on it. Because she had no operand shielding, the latter used his own body to physically block the starlight summoned by Eos.

spans.text: She looks aside, at the heavily-wounded Atlas, whose face has a pained grimace on it. Because she had no operand shielding, the latter used his own body to physically block the starlight summoned by Eos.

units.rawText: However, that all ends now.
units.displayText: However, that all ends now.

spans.text: However, that all ends now.

units.rawText: Electra raises her daggers and nicks Eos' throat with them. Blood-red operands drip from the wound, staining the pure white of the Pantheon.
units.displayText: Electra raises her daggers and nicks Eos' throat with them. Blood-red operands drip from the wound, staining the pure white of the Pantheon.

spans.text: Electra raises her daggers and nicks Eos' throat with them. Blood-red operands drip from the wound, staining the pure white of the Pantheon.

units.rawText: Last words... No, I'd rather you treated them as a form of persuasion.
units.displayText: Last words... No, I'd rather you treated them as a form of persuasion.

spans.text: Last words... No, I'd rather you treated them as a form of persuasion.

units.rawText: <size=40>...What are you even trying to say?!</size>
units.displayText: ...What are you even trying to say?!

spans.text: ...What are you even trying to say?!

units.rawText: Unable to hide the anger in her heart, she stabs her operand-wreathed daggers at Eos' core.
units.displayText: Unable to hide the anger in her heart, she stabs her operand-wreathed daggers at Eos' core.

spans.text: Unable to hide the anger in her heart, she stabs her operand-wreathed daggers at Eos' core.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: Ngh!
units.displayText: Ngh!

spans.text: Ngh!

units.rawText: An operand barrier... But you won't be able to protect yourself with it for long.
units.displayText: An operand barrier... But you won't be able to protect yourself with it for long.

spans.text: An operand barrier... But you won't be able to protect yourself with it for long.

units.rawText: The white-haired Sanctifier does not answer, only struggles to drag her wounded body up and off the ground.
units.displayText: The white-haired Sanctifier does not answer, only struggles to drag her wounded body up and off the ground.

spans.text: The white-haired Sanctifier does not answer, only struggles to drag her wounded body up and off the ground.

units.rawText: ...Something has felt off ever since we entered the Pantheon and I spoke with you.
units.displayText: ...Something has felt off ever since we entered the Pantheon and I spoke with you.

spans.text: ...Something has felt off ever since we entered the Pantheon and I spoke with you.

units.rawText: Although you've managed to imitate Electra very well, you're a fake, and not an individual restored from the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: Although you've managed to imitate Electra very well, you're a fake, and not an individual restored from the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: Although you've managed to imitate Electra very well, you're a fake, and not an individual restored from the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: You simply projected the image you had in your heart onto them... Just like with those beverages.
units.displayText: You simply projected the image you had in your heart onto them... Just like with those beverages.

spans.text: You simply projected the image you had in your heart onto them... Just like with those beverages.

units.rawText: Eos, are you saying that Electra made all these beverages here?
units.displayText: Eos, are you saying that Electra made all these beverages here?

spans.text: Eos, are you saying that Electra made all these beverages here?

units.rawText: That's what gives me pause, Professor.
units.displayText: That's what gives me pause, Professor.

spans.text: That's what gives me pause, Professor.

units.rawText: To my knowledge, the only person among the Sanctifiers who would do this is Electra, but...
units.displayText: To my knowledge, the only person among the Sanctifiers who would do this is Electra, but...

spans.text: To my knowledge, the only person among the Sanctifiers who would do this is Electra, but...

units.rawText: But we all know Electra died in Tartarus, a long time ago.
units.displayText: But we all know Electra died in Tartarus, a long time ago.

spans.text: But we all know Electra died in Tartarus, a long time ago.

units.rawText: ...Mhm.
units.displayText: ...Mhm.

spans.text: ...Mhm.

units.rawText: What's even more strange is that these beverages don't look like they've been placed here for long. It looks more like they were made recently.
units.displayText: What's even more strange is that these beverages don't look like they've been placed here for long. It looks more like they were made recently.

spans.text: What's even more strange is that these beverages don't look like they've been placed here for long. It looks more like they were made recently.

units.rawText: Putting all this together leads me to an absurd hypothesis...
units.displayText: Putting all this together leads me to an absurd hypothesis...

spans.text: Putting all this together leads me to an absurd hypothesis...

units.rawText: ...What if Eosphorus actually succeeded in "reviving" the previous generation of Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: ...What if Eosphorus actually succeeded in "reviving" the previous generation of Sanctifiers?

spans.text: ...What if Eosphorus actually succeeded in "reviving" the previous generation of Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: Perhaps I was being influenced by my wish for it to be true, but although I truly thought my friends had been revived...
units.displayText: Perhaps I was being influenced by my wish for it to be true, but although I truly thought my friends had been revived...

spans.text: Perhaps I was being influenced by my wish for it to be true, but although I truly thought my friends had been revived...

units.rawText: ...I soon realized that those beverages didn't smell strange, much less taste strange.
units.displayText: ...I soon realized that those beverages didn't smell strange, much less taste strange.

spans.text: ...I soon realized that those beverages didn't smell strange, much less taste strange.

units.rawText: Much like these puppets, they were nothing more than a facade.
units.displayText: Much like these puppets, they were nothing more than a facade.

spans.text: Much like these puppets, they were nothing more than a facade.

units.rawText: ...Is that one of Electra's beverages? Why do you still have it with you?
units.displayText: ...Is that one of Electra's beverages? Why do you still have it with you?

spans.text: ...Is that one of Electra's beverages? Why do you still have it with you?

units.rawText: Mmm, there was something just now that was bothering me. When Electra made her beverages, they usually had a fragrant smell to draw us in, but that hidden storeroom only had a musty, long-sealed odor to it.
units.displayText: Mmm, there was something just now that was bothering me. When Electra made her beverages, they usually had a fragrant smell to draw us in, but that hidden storeroom only had a musty, long-sealed odor to it.

spans.text: Mmm, there was something just now that was bothering me. When Electra made her beverages, they usually had a fragrant smell to draw us in, but that hidden storeroom only had a musty, long-sealed odor to it.

units.rawText: Which means...
units.displayText: Which means...

spans.text: Which means...

units.rawText: I don't answer; instead, I dip my index finger into the liquid within the bottle, and after hesitating for a moment, I lick it before the astonished eyes of my companions.
units.displayText: I don't answer; instead, I dip my index finger into the liquid within the bottle, and after hesitating for a moment, I lick it before the astonished eyes of my companions.

spans.text: I don't answer; instead, I dip my index finger into the liquid within the bottle, and after hesitating for a moment, I lick it before the astonished eyes of my companions.

units.rawText: Miss Eos?!
units.displayText: Miss Eos?!

spans.text: Miss Eos?!

units.rawText: I knew it... It's tasteless.
units.displayText: I knew it... It's tasteless.

spans.text: I knew it... It's tasteless.

units.rawText: I smile bitterly, and hand it to the Professor for analysis.
units.displayText: I smile bitterly, and hand it to the Professor for analysis.

spans.text: I smile bitterly, and hand it to the Professor for analysis.

units.rawText: Indeed... It looks strange, but in terms of taste and effects, it's no different from ordinary drinking water. It's not the beverage we were expecting.
units.displayText: Indeed... It looks strange, but in terms of taste and effects, it's no different from ordinary drinking water. It's not the beverage we were expecting.

spans.text: Indeed... It looks strange, but in terms of taste and effects, it's no different from ordinary drinking water. It's not the beverage we were expecting.

units.rawText: In other words, it wasn't made by Electra, but only looks like it was?
units.displayText: In other words, it wasn't made by Electra, but only looks like it was?

spans.text: In other words, it wasn't made by Electra, but only looks like it was?

units.rawText: ...Yes, which is why I'm saying that the dead haven't come back to life or anything.
units.displayText: ...Yes, which is why I'm saying that the dead haven't come back to life or anything.

spans.text: ...Yes, which is why I'm saying that the dead haven't come back to life or anything.

units.rawText: Well, I suppose that makes sense. How could anyone revoke deaths in the past?
units.displayText: Well, I suppose that makes sense. How could anyone revoke deaths in the past?

spans.text: Well, I suppose that makes sense. How could anyone revoke deaths in the past?

units.rawText: I put the glass down and a sentimental look crosses my face.
units.displayText: I put the glass down and a sentimental look crosses my face.

spans.text: I put the glass down and a sentimental look crosses my face.

units.rawText: Eosphorus just wants to pretend he's back in the past. He never understood how Electra made her beverages. Naturally, he wouldn't be able to recreate their taste.
units.displayText: Eosphorus just wants to pretend he's back in the past. He never understood how Electra made her beverages. Naturally, he wouldn't be able to recreate their taste.

spans.text: Eosphorus just wants to pretend he's back in the past. He never understood how Electra made her beverages. Naturally, he wouldn't be able to recreate their taste.

units.rawText: He's just...
units.displayText: He's just...

spans.text: He's just...

units.rawText: <color=orange>You're just drowning yourself in the past, Eosphorus.</color>
units.displayText: You're just drowning yourself in the past, Eosphorus.

spans.text: You're just drowning yourself in the past, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: You're just drowning yourself in the past, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: You're just drowning yourself in the past, Eosphorus.

spans.text: You're just drowning yourself in the past, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Starlight and shot strike their targets' cores simultaneously, and without a shield to protect them, they instantly crumble.
units.displayText: Starlight and shot strike their targets' cores simultaneously, and without a shield to protect them, they instantly crumble.

spans.text: Starlight and shot strike their targets' cores simultaneously, and without a shield to protect them, they instantly crumble.

units.rawText: ...I believe you know that an attack of this level cannot harm me.
units.displayText: ...I believe you know that an attack of this level cannot harm me.

spans.text: ...I believe you know that an attack of this level cannot harm me.

units.rawText: I know that, but my aim was to rip off your mask... Eosphorus.
units.displayText: I know that, but my aim was to rip off your mask... Eosphorus.

spans.text: I know that, but my aim was to rip off your mask... Eosphorus.

units.rawText: The world shudders. The warmth and nostalgia of the Reverse Tower's past is ruthlessly torn away, revealing the Entropized ruins beneath.
units.displayText: The world shudders. The warmth and nostalgia of the Reverse Tower's past is ruthlessly torn away, revealing the Entropized ruins beneath.

spans.text: The world shudders. The warmth and nostalgia of the Reverse Tower's past is ruthlessly torn away, revealing the Entropized ruins beneath.

units.rawText: As the decay is revealed, the puppets all shed their disguises as well, transforming into silver-haired Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: As the decay is revealed, the puppets all shed their disguises as well, transforming into silver-haired Sanctifiers.

spans.text: As the decay is revealed, the puppets all shed their disguises as well, transforming into silver-haired Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Since they are not equipped even with basic neural clouds, they reflexively claw at the beautiful scenes that are long gone, but the only thing they find purchase on is endless emptiness.
units.displayText: Since they are not equipped even with basic neural clouds, they reflexively claw at the beautiful scenes that are long gone, but the only thing they find purchase on is endless emptiness.

spans.text: Since they are not equipped even with basic neural clouds, they reflexively claw at the beautiful scenes that are long gone, but the only thing they find purchase on is endless emptiness.

units.rawText: ...What have you done?
units.displayText: ...What have you done?

spans.text: ...What have you done?

units.rawText: I merely blended a projection-removal program into my attacks to expose your true identity.
units.displayText: I merely blended a projection-removal program into my attacks to expose your true identity.

spans.text: I merely blended a projection-removal program into my attacks to expose your true identity.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, the deaths of Electra and the others are an incontrovertible reality. No matter how well you impersonate them, you can't fool your own neural cloud.
units.displayText: Eosphorus, the deaths of Electra and the others are an incontrovertible reality. No matter how well you impersonate them, you can't fool your own neural cloud.

spans.text: Eosphorus, the deaths of Electra and the others are an incontrovertible reality. No matter how well you impersonate them, you can't fool your own neural cloud.

units.rawText: All these illusions can do is sound like you want and give you the approval you want. But the real Electra would never agree to letting you destroy Magrasea and ruin the home they protected.
units.displayText: All these illusions can do is sound like you want and give you the approval you want. But the real Electra would never agree to letting you destroy Magrasea and ruin the home they protected.

spans.text: All these illusions can do is sound like you want and give you the approval you want. But the real Electra would never agree to letting you destroy Magrasea and ruin the home they protected.

units.rawText: What do you know about them... about me?!
units.displayText: What do you know about them... about me?!

spans.text: What do you know about them... about me?!

units.rawText: You're nothing more than a phantom of the past, you're not her...
units.displayText: You're nothing more than a phantom of the past, you're not her...

spans.text: You're nothing more than a phantom of the past, you're not her...

units.rawText: After being revealed, the clone tries to attack with rays of starlight, but his operand reserves have run dry from his previous rage-fueled rampage.
units.displayText: After being revealed, the clone tries to attack with rays of starlight, but his operand reserves have run dry from his previous rage-fueled rampage.

spans.text: After being revealed, the clone tries to attack with rays of starlight, but his operand reserves have run dry from his previous rage-fueled rampage.

units.rawText: Damn it all...
units.displayText: Damn it all...

spans.text: Damn it all...

units.rawText: When the starlight fades once again, his form vanishes into the infinite void as well.
units.displayText: When the starlight fades once again, his form vanishes into the infinite void as well.

spans.text: When the starlight fades once again, his form vanishes into the infinite void as well.

units.rawText: Are you not a phantom as well?
units.displayText: Are you not a phantom as well?

spans.text: Are you not a phantom as well?

units.rawText: As the disguise programs terminate one after another, the scenes around Eos crumble and vanish.
units.displayText: As the disguise programs terminate one after another, the scenes around Eos crumble and vanish.

spans.text: As the disguise programs terminate one after another, the scenes around Eos crumble and vanish.

units.rawText: The puppet corpses fade away, revealing the secret Eosphorus has hidden here...
units.displayText: The puppet corpses fade away, revealing the secret Eosphorus has hidden here...

spans.text: The puppet corpses fade away, revealing the secret Eosphorus has hidden here...

units.rawText: Rumble—
units.displayText: Rumble—

spans.text: Rumble—

units.rawText: Grinding noises come from all over the Reverse Tower as the illusions cloaking it fall away one after another.
units.displayText: Grinding noises come from all over the Reverse Tower as the illusions cloaking it fall away one after another.

spans.text: Grinding noises come from all over the Reverse Tower as the illusions cloaking it fall away one after another.

units.rawText: Without its disguise, the Pantheon is no longer the pure and sacred place it used to be. Ominous purple ooze desecrates the oaths carved on its walls in the distance.
units.displayText: Without its disguise, the Pantheon is no longer the pure and sacred place it used to be. Ominous purple ooze desecrates the oaths carved on its walls in the distance.

spans.text: Without its disguise, the Pantheon is no longer the pure and sacred place it used to be. Ominous purple ooze desecrates the oaths carved on its walls in the distance.

units.rawText: Look around you, Eosphorus. This is what you have done to the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: Look around you, Eosphorus. This is what you have done to the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: Look around you, Eosphorus. This is what you have done to the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: Electra and the others aren't real. They're nothing more than your twisted delusions given simulated life.
units.displayText: Electra and the others aren't real. They're nothing more than your twisted delusions given simulated life.

spans.text: Electra and the others aren't real. They're nothing more than your twisted delusions given simulated life.

units.rawText: You and I both know the weight of death and sacrifice... So you should stop defiling their memory any further.
units.displayText: You and I both know the weight of death and sacrifice... So you should stop defiling their memory any further.

spans.text: You and I both know the weight of death and sacrifice... So you should stop defiling their memory any further.

units.rawText: <size=40>SHUT UP!</size>
units.displayText: SHUT UP!

spans.text: SHUT UP!

units.rawText: Eosphorus' clone ducks away from the plume of fire my gun spits and throws the dagger he is holding.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' clone ducks away from the plume of fire my gun spits and throws the dagger he is holding.

spans.text: Eosphorus' clone ducks away from the plume of fire my gun spits and throws the dagger he is holding.

units.rawText: ...Dream on.
units.displayText: ...Dream on.

spans.text: ...Dream on.

units.rawText: A pink figure flashes past me, cutting the dagger out of the air as it does.
units.displayText: A pink figure flashes past me, cutting the dagger out of the air as it does.

spans.text: A pink figure flashes past me, cutting the dagger out of the air as it does.

units.rawText: Persicaria!
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: I'm glad I made it in time.
units.displayText: I'm glad I made it in time.

spans.text: I'm glad I made it in time.

units.rawText: Persicaria pushes me behind her and points her sword at her enemy.
units.displayText: Persicaria pushes me behind her and points her sword at her enemy.

spans.text: Persicaria pushes me behind her and points her sword at her enemy.

units.rawText: He's Eosphorus? Professor, I'm not sensing that oppressive aura from before. Why is that?
units.displayText: He's Eosphorus? Professor, I'm not sensing that oppressive aura from before. Why is that?

spans.text: He's Eosphorus? Professor, I'm not sensing that oppressive aura from before. Why is that?

units.rawText: ...He's not the real Eosphorus. This guy in front of us is nothing more than a clone.
units.displayText: ...He's not the real Eosphorus. This guy in front of us is nothing more than a clone.

spans.text: ...He's not the real Eosphorus. This guy in front of us is nothing more than a clone.

units.rawText: Compared to puppets who can only follow the orders they're given, it was probably easier to split off a copy of himself and disguise it, then have it act out its assigned role.
units.displayText: Compared to puppets who can only follow the orders they're given, it was probably easier to split off a copy of himself and disguise it, then have it act out its assigned role.

spans.text: Compared to puppets who can only follow the orders they're given, it was probably easier to split off a copy of himself and disguise it, then have it act out its assigned role.

units.rawText: In other words, the Atlas, Electra and Alcyone... All those phantoms of the past were all him?
units.displayText: In other words, the Atlas, Electra and Alcyone... All those phantoms of the past were all him?

spans.text: In other words, the Atlas, Electra and Alcyone... All those phantoms of the past were all him?

units.rawText: Most likely. He was probably using these illusions to hide his actual movements. In all likelihood, he's no longer in the tower.
units.displayText: Most likely. He was probably using these illusions to hide his actual movements. In all likelihood, he's no longer in the tower.

spans.text: Most likely. He was probably using these illusions to hide his actual movements. In all likelihood, he's no longer in the tower.

units.rawText: ...That's just pitiable.
units.displayText: ...That's just pitiable.

spans.text: ...That's just pitiable.

units.rawText: Persicaria shakes her head and quickly organizes her thoughts.
units.displayText: Persicaria shakes her head and quickly organizes her thoughts.

spans.text: Persicaria shakes her head and quickly organizes her thoughts.

units.rawText: It seems this was how he hid Antonina and Professor Irida as well.
units.displayText: It seems this was how he hid Antonina and Professor Irida as well.

spans.text: It seems this was how he hid Antonina and Professor Irida as well.

units.rawText: Our top priority is to keep Eosphorus from traveling to the real world. Since his disguise program is ineffective and Eosphorus has left the Reverse Tower, we need to rescue Antonina and Professor Irida, and then intercept Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Our top priority is to keep Eosphorus from traveling to the real world. Since his disguise program is ineffective and Eosphorus has left the Reverse Tower, we need to rescue Antonina and Professor Irida, and then intercept Eosphorus.

spans.text: Our top priority is to keep Eosphorus from traveling to the real world. Since his disguise program is ineffective and Eosphorus has left the Reverse Tower, we need to rescue Antonina and Professor Irida, and then intercept Eosphorus.

units.rawText: No need to go to that trouble. Don't forget, you guys aren't the only ones fighting here.
units.displayText: No need to go to that trouble. Don't forget, you guys aren't the only ones fighting here.

spans.text: No need to go to that trouble. Don't forget, you guys aren't the only ones fighting here.

units.rawText: Before I can reply, the owner of that voice appears through a door that opens in the Pantheon.
units.displayText: Before I can reply, the owner of that voice appears through a door that opens in the Pantheon.

spans.text: Before I can reply, the owner of that voice appears through a door that opens in the Pantheon.

units.rawText: Looks like things went well for you in Tartarus. Well done.
units.displayText: Looks like things went well for you in Tartarus. Well done.

spans.text: Looks like things went well for you in Tartarus. Well done.

units.rawText: Eh... I've got a ton of questions for you, but let's get rid of these annoying illusions first.
units.displayText: Eh... I've got a ton of questions for you, but let's get rid of these annoying illusions first.

spans.text: Eh... I've got a ton of questions for you, but let's get rid of these annoying illusions first.

units.rawText: <size=40>Professor Irida! Antonina!</size>
units.displayText: Professor Irida! Antonina!

spans.text: Professor Irida! Antonina!

units.rawText: Yup, we're back.
units.displayText: Yup, we're back.

spans.text: Yup, we're back.

units.rawText: Ever since Eosphorus locked us up, we were trying to escape, but his disguise program messed with the local topology and jammed signals, so we couldn't call for outside help.
units.displayText: Ever since Eosphorus locked us up, we were trying to escape, but his disguise program messed with the local topology and jammed signals, so we couldn't call for outside help.

spans.text: Ever since Eosphorus locked us up, we were trying to escape, but his disguise program messed with the local topology and jammed signals, so we couldn't call for outside help.

units.rawText: We only managed to escape because you broke his illusions. Plus, Eos showing up meant we could get away safely.
units.displayText: We only managed to escape because you broke his illusions. Plus, Eos showing up meant we could get away safely.

spans.text: We only managed to escape because you broke his illusions. Plus, Eos showing up meant we could get away safely.

units.rawText: (Yawns) I mean, we're not hurt, but being trapped in the same place all the time is boring as hell.
units.displayText: (Yawns) I mean, we're not hurt, but being trapped in the same place all the time is boring as hell.

spans.text: (Yawns) I mean, we're not hurt, but being trapped in the same place all the time is boring as hell.

units.rawText: Please do not mess with my computer the next time you're bored, thank you very much.
units.displayText: Please do not mess with my computer the next time you're bored, thank you very much.

spans.text: Please do not mess with my computer the next time you're bored, thank you very much.

units.rawText: Well, I'm just glad you're alright. Now...
units.displayText: Well, I'm just glad you're alright. Now...

spans.text: Well, I'm just glad you're alright. Now...

units.rawText: Your analysis was spot on, we need to move ASAP. Eosphorus is on the way to the Neural Cloud Sector.
units.displayText: Your analysis was spot on, we need to move ASAP. Eosphorus is on the way to the Neural Cloud Sector.

spans.text: Your analysis was spot on, we need to move ASAP. Eosphorus is on the way to the Neural Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: Professor Irida has a stern look on her face as she shows a screen to us. The countdown indicates the passage of time.
units.displayText: Professor Irida has a stern look on her face as she shows a screen to us. The countdown indicates the passage of time.

spans.text: Professor Irida has a stern look on her face as she shows a screen to us. The countdown indicates the passage of time.

units.rawText: Eos is helping to delay the phantoms that were chasing us and she'll be here soon, but there are still many obstacles here that Eosphorus left behind to delay us. We need to get rid of them quickly and catch up with him.
units.displayText: Eos is helping to delay the phantoms that were chasing us and she'll be here soon, but there are still many obstacles here that Eosphorus left behind to delay us. We need to get rid of them quickly and catch up with him.

spans.text: Eos is helping to delay the phantoms that were chasing us and she'll be here soon, but there are still many obstacles here that Eosphorus left behind to delay us. We need to get rid of them quickly and catch up with him.

units.rawText: ...Look out!
units.displayText: ...Look out!

spans.text: ...Look out!

units.rawText: The Eosphorus clones suddenly appear and rain down countless rays of starlight at their defenseless backs.
units.displayText: The Eosphorus clones suddenly appear and rain down countless rays of starlight at their defenseless backs.

spans.text: The Eosphorus clones suddenly appear and rain down countless rays of starlight at their defenseless backs.

units.rawText: Just then, a white-haired Greater Sanctifier appears to deflect all their attacks with her shield.
units.displayText: Just then, a white-haired Greater Sanctifier appears to deflect all their attacks with her shield.

spans.text: Just then, a white-haired Greater Sanctifier appears to deflect all their attacks with her shield.

units.rawText: Eos, you're back.
units.displayText: Eos, you're back.

spans.text: Eos, you're back.

units.rawText: Yes, and just in time too, it seems. Is everyone alright?
units.displayText: Yes, and just in time too, it seems. Is everyone alright?

units.rawText: Eos! Are you okay?
units.displayText: Eos! Are you okay?

spans.text: Eos! Are you okay?

units.rawText: Yes, it's no big deal. I'm glad to see you alive and well, Professor.
units.displayText: Yes, it's no big deal. I'm glad to see you alive and well, Professor.

spans.text: Yes, it's no big deal. I'm glad to see you alive and well, Professor.

units.rawText: She dispels the shield and gathers up the lingering operands before heading over to Persicaria's side, a caring look on her face.
units.displayText: She dispels the shield and gathers up the lingering operands before heading over to Persicaria's side, a caring look on her face.

spans.text: She dispels the shield and gathers up the lingering operands before heading over to Persicaria's side, a caring look on her face.

units.rawText: Miss Persicaria, I am also glad to see that you are well.
units.displayText: Miss Persicaria, I am also glad to see that you are well.

spans.text: Miss Persicaria, I am also glad to see that you are well.

units.rawText: I'm fine... But you can just call me Persicaria from now on, Eos.
units.displayText: I'm fine... But you can just call me Persicaria from now on, Eos.

spans.text: I'm fine... But you can just call me Persicaria from now on, Eos.

units.rawText: It's better that way, seeing as we're friends from the Oasis.
units.displayText: It's better that way, seeing as we're friends from the Oasis.

spans.text: It's better that way, seeing as we're friends from the Oasis.

units.rawText: Yes, I understand, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Yes, I understand, Persicaria.

spans.text: Yes, I understand, Persicaria.

units.rawText: With their faith rekindled, the two of them stand before us, squaring off against the dozens of phantom clones floating in the air before us.
units.displayText: With their faith rekindled, the two of them stand before us, squaring off against the dozens of phantom clones floating in the air before us.

units.rawText: <color=orange>You should give up, Eosphorus. You can gather up all the false projections you want, but they'll never give you the reality you crave.</color>
